evidenceNote: Every number in this file is a conservative PLANNING DEFAULT for a routine organiser. None is a clinically validated frequency, and no authoritative source located gives a specific nights-per-week figure for OTC products. Product directions and prescriber instructions always override these defaults.
rinseOffHandling: Rinse-off products (cleansers, washes) do not use the leave-on caps. They use the product's own directions; if none are entered they fall back to the leave-on defaults and the UI says so. Insufficient evidence located to set separate rinse-off numbers.

notes.removedFromV1: vitamin-c (7 / 4) was removed: it is every-routine in ingredients.json, formulations vary, and no source supports the numbers.
notes.sensitiveSetting: sensitiveNights applies when profile.sensitive is true. It is a user-chosen preference, not a diagnosis.
notes.multiActiveProducts: A product with several scheduled actives uses the LOWEST effective nights among them, so it is never placed more often than its most restrictive active.
notes.overrides: product.directions.nightsPerWeek above maxUserNights is only accepted when product.directions.source is 'clinician'.
